others.route: Permis de travail (ministre chargé du travail)

note: Benin: a foreign or immigrant worker's contract is endorsed by the Ministry of Labour only on a work permit the Minister issues, for twelve months and renewable, and may be refused where the worker's qualification doesn't meet the economy's needs; in the first two years of residence a foreigner works only on fixed-term contracts, unless an agreement Benin has made says otherwise (Labour Code, Law 98-004, arts. 26–29). No days without the permit. ECOWAS citizens work as nationals do (the ecowas list).

sources.title: Loi n° 98-004 du 27 janvier 1998 portant Code du Travail en République du Bénin, arts. 26–29 (Secrétariat Général du Gouvernement)
sources.said: Article 27 : Le visa du contrat du travailleur étranger ou immigrant est subordonné à la présentation d'un permis de travail délivré par le ministre chargé du travail.
